description: OSHA severe injury reports cover in-patient hospitalization, amputation, and loss of an eye. The tool counts reports by year for one worksite or sums them across one employer's worksites. It covers Federal OSHA states only, from 2015 to November 2025. It counts only reports whose name and street address match the worksite. It returns no report text or detail about the injured worker.

employer_id.description: The employer_id from a worksite record.

name: get_severe_injuries
title: Get severe injury reports
